svg.title: Access setup order: GitHub OAuth App, then IdP, then policy, then Access apps
svg.desc: Do not create Access applications first. They deny by default. Register the GitHub OAuth App in GitHub's UI (no API), add it as a Zero Trust identity provider, write the Allow policy, then attach Access apps to both hostnames.
svg.text: Access setup order: GitHub OAuth App, then IdP, then policy, then Access apps
